newsitem.title: JAMAICA: Jamaica chicken chain looks to franchise abroad.
newsitem.headline: Jamaica chicken chain looks to franchise abroad.

text.p: In a reversal of the trend in recent years for foreign-based chains to franchise into Jamaica, a Jamaican restaurant firm is looking to open its own franchise outlets abroad.

Chicken Supreme, a local fast-food outlet specializing in Jamaican-style flame-broiled chicken dinners, operates two outlets in Kingston and one in Montego Bay, with a fourth planned for Ocho Rios, the company said.

Within the next few months, the company will also open its first overseas operations with an outlet in London. The privately-held company, part of the local Chang Associated Group, was also looking at opportunities in Barbados, Sierra Leone and South Africa, according to group director Tony Chang.
The new British outlet is expected to cost about $165,000 -- less than the planned Ocho Rios restaurant, Chang noted, due to the high Jamaican duty on imported equipment.
The UK outlet was expected to open by mid-1997.
